full_judgment: 10. Abul Kashem as DW 1 stated that RS khatian was prepared in the name of Ebad and Ekram. He stated that RS record prepared without the names of Ebad and Ekram was wrong and that he filed Other Suit No. 1286 of 1973 which was decreed ex parte. The present plaintiffs were defendants in the Other Suit No. 1286 of 1973 and notices were duly served upon the defendants. He purchased the suit property with different sale deeds. He also deposed that RS record was correct. He denied that the plaintiffs are the owners of 4.17 acres of land. Amalnama and rent receipt filed by the plaintiffs were fraudulent and collusive documents. He proved the CS and RS khatian which were duly marked as Exhibits. In cross-examination he stated that the plaintiffs story of pattan is false. Out of the 6 plots Majam received his share measuring 1.14 acres. Remaining area of land are being possessed by the defendants. He denied that summons and notices of Other Suit No. 1286 of 1973 were suppressed and the ex parte decree was obtained collusively. In cross-examination he denied that the plaintiffs did not possess the suit land. He also denied that the plaintiffs have had their homestead in plot No. 955. In cross-examination, he stated that out of the suit land the plaintiffs possess plot No. 956 and remaining 5 plots were possessed by the defendants. He denied that he was deposing falsely. DW 2 in examination-in-chief stated that he knew the suit land. The plaintiffs possess the suit land in plot No. 956 and remaining land is being possessed by the other co-sharers. In cross-examination he denied that he had possessed illegally. DW 3 in cross-examination stated that he know the suit land which was comprising of 6 plots. The plaintiffs possess plot No. 956 and the remaining 5 plots were possessed by the other co-sharers. The defendants have their homestead in plot No. 955. In cross-examination DW 3 stated that he has no land adjacent to the suit land but his land is that suit land. He denied that he had not deposed falsely.
